geo.caveat: Each flashpoint is measured against its own trailing 30-day median, so a long-running conflict does not sit at maximum forever. This measures how loud a story is relative to its own normal - not what will happen.

profile.name: Fed Chair Speaks
profile.what: Any scheduled appearance by the Fed Chair - testimony, conference remarks, or a moderated Q&A.
profile.why_gold: The Chair sets the policy narrative between meetings. A single sentence on the balance of risks can move the rate curve as much as a data release.
profile.watch: Whether the venue allows questions. Prepared remarks are usually safe; unscripted Q&A is where the surprises come from.
profile.gotchas: No forecast number exists, so nothing is priced in. The risk is pure tone, which makes it hard to hedge and easy to get run over by.
